SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Diary 2
REPORT
174'
5 3 43

Chengtu Road Police Station. Misc. File No. 38/43. Date March 4th, 1943.

SUBJECT: Anti-Japanese Pamphlets Found Posted on Race Course Road.

On the morning of 4-3-43 a witness named:-
Tai Foh Kung (戴福根), 21, Soochow,
S/Tailor, residing at 16 Zung Chi Li
(衆啟里), Race Course Road, (C.C.No. 49009)
was located who stated that at 11.30 p.m. 2-3-43, whilst
on duty as Vigilance Corps member on Race Course Road
between Lungmen Road and Yu Ya Ching Road (No. 15 Post),
he saw three male Chinese, descriptions as follows
coming from the West and posting up a pamphlet on the
fence enclosing the Race Course opposite Lane No. 63
Race Course Road:-

(1) Age about 30 years, height about 5'6", wearing
dark coloured Chung San dress, medium build,
Soochow dialect. (This man carried the pamphlets
in his pocket and actually carried out the
posting)
(2) Age about 30 years, height about 5'6", wearing
dark coloured Chung San dress, medium build,
(This man applied the paste to the fence with
a brush)
(3) Age about 28, height about 5'5", wearing dark
coloured Chung San dress, and brown woollen
sleeping cap, medium build, (This man carried
a pail of paste, the pail being about 1 foot
in height and 5" in diameter) top half white
coloured and bottom half black).

The witness went up to see, but being illiterate
did not understand the meaning of the pamphlet. He was
told by the 1st described person that it was an
advertisement.

The witness then paid no more attention and went
away while the three men proceeded eastward.

Corporal Ochiai of the Japanese Gendarmerie Race
Course Detachment attended Ch. Rd. Stn at 2 p.m. and
questioned the witness, after which the latter was allowed
to go.
島哲一
D.S.I. Sameshima.

Copy sent to O. i/c, Sec. 5,
C. & S. B., Headquarters.

（左侧竖排文字及印章）

成都路捕房。杂项档案号 38/43。日期：1943年3月4日。

事由：在跑马厅路发现张贴反日传单。

1943年3月4日上午，找到一名名为：
戴福根 (Tai Foh Kung)，21岁，苏州人，
职业：裁缝，住址：跑马厅路众启里16号
（中央身份证号码 49009）
的证人，该证人称：1943年3月2日晚上11时30分，当他在龙门路与虞洽卿路之间（第15岗哨）的跑马厅路担任守望队队员执勤时，看见三名中国男子，特征如下，从西边走来，并在跑马厅路63弄对面围住跑马厅的栅栏上张贴传单：

(1) 年龄约30岁，身高约5英尺6英寸，身穿深色中山装，中等身材，说苏州话。（此人将传单放在口袋里，并实际执行了张贴动作）
(2) 年龄约30岁，身高约5英尺6英寸，身穿深色中山装，中等身材，（此人用刷子在栅栏上涂抹浆糊）
(3) 年龄约28岁，身高约5英尺5英寸，身穿深色中山装，头戴棕色羊毛睡帽，中等身材，（此人提着一桶浆糊，桶高约1英尺，直径5英寸，上半部分为白色，下半部分为黑色）。

证人上前查看，但因不识字，不懂传单的含义。上述第1名男子告诉他那是广告。

随后证人不再关注并离开，而那三人则向东走去。

日本宪兵队跑马厅分遣队的落合曹长于下午2时来到成都路捕房讯问证人，之后允许证人离开。
島哲一
特别调查员 鲛岛 (D.S.I. Sameshima)。

副本送交总部刑务及侦缉处第五科主管警官。

（左侧竖排文字及印章）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Chengtu Road Station. File No. Misc. 38/4 Date March 2, 1943.

SUBJECT: Anti-Japanese Pamphlets Found Posted on RaceCourse Road

Sir,

At 11 p.m. 2 '3/43, C.D.S. 227 and C.D.C. 452, whilst on patrol duty, discovered about 20 pamphlets of an anti-Japanese nature and addressed to members of the Vigilance Corps, posted on walls and fences on Race Course Road between Mohawk Road and the Race Course Apartments.

The pamphlets, which were written with Chinese ink, read as follows:

"Oppressed members of the Vigilance Corps! Are you willing to act as the claws and teeth of the Japanese devils?"

"Oppressed members of the Vigilance Corps! Are you willing to obstruct the patriotic movement?"

Etc, etc.

The detectives mentioned above kept careful observation in the vicinity, but no arrests were effected.

All the pamphlets have been removed and brought to the station or destroyed. Specimens are attached hereto.

成都路捕房。档案号：杂项 38/4 日期：1943年3月2日。

事由：在跑马厅路发现张贴反日传单

先生，

1943年3月2日晚上11时，便衣警探 227号和便衣巡捕 452号在巡逻执勤期间，发现在莫霍克路 (Mohawk Road) 与跑马厅公寓之间的跑马厅路的墙壁和栅栏上，张贴了约20份针对守望队成员的反日性质传单。

这些传单用墨汁书写，内容如下：

“受压迫的守望队队员们！你们愿意充当日本魔鬼的爪牙吗？”

“受压迫的守望队队员们！你们愿意阻碍爱国运动吗？”

等等，等等。

上述警探在该地区进行了严密监视，但未实施逮捕。

所有传单已被移除并带回捕房或销毁。样本附后。

（左侧竖排手写批注及印章）
第二科长
